observations.observation: Fantasy Nerds, citing Yahoo Sports, reported that Nike's Specter Edition alternates for 2026-27 drew wide online backlash once the designs leaked. The report is league-wide and names no Pistons-specific reaction.

observations.timeframe: Published Sept 10, 2026, the day after the reveal
observations.limitations: Secondhand summary of social media reaction, so directional only. No Detroit sample, no poll, and early reaction may soften by the first wear date.

observations.observation: Vintage Detroit describes the 1996-2001 teal horsehead look as polarizing, and notes the team went back to blue, white and red after five seasons.
observations.audience: Detroit fans who lived through the teal era, as told by a local history site
observations.timeframe: Covers 1996-2001; the page shows no publication date
observations.limitations: One writer's retrospective, not a survey. It shows the teal look was divisive then, which tempers the brief's 'cult favorite' framing but says nothing about demand today.

observations.observation: The Big Lead lists Cade Cunningham 14th among the NBA's top-selling jerseys for 2025-26. The Game PH also places him 14th for the 2025-26 regular season.
observations.audience: National jersey buyers, including Pistons fans who buy through league channels
observations.timeframe: 2025-26 season; The Big Lead labels its list 'so far', so it may be a mid-season snapshot
observations.limitations: Rank only, no unit numbers. Not split by city, so it can't show how much of the demand is local or which jersey edition sold.

source.title: NBA: Top-selling jerseys so far in 2025-26 season

observations.observation: The NBA's 2023-24 team merchandise ranking had the Lakers first and the Celtics second, with the Pistons outside the top 10. Its top-15 jersey list did not include Cunningham.
observations.audience: National buyers of NBA team merchandise
observations.timeframe: 2023-24 season, before the turnaround; no publication date shown
observations.limitations: Two seasons old and from a losing year. Useful only as a baseline, not as a read on 2026-27 demand.

observations.timeframe: No date shown; the excerpt mentions a 2025 playoffs hat and a Knicks series, so it likely covers the 2025 run
